name: Proper Stable Sample Compression of K4 Incidence with Empty Set
proof: Section \ref{val:proper_unlabeled_sample_compression_k4_incidence_with_empty} proves that every proper unlabeled scheme has width at least three and constructs a proper width-three scheme preserving the selected key on every intermediate subsample. Its lower argument does not assume stability, while its upper scheme satisfies a stronger condition than reconstruction stability. Therefore psUSC is exactly three.
